# HanovaDevs

> Software company founded in 2022 by Ali Haider. Custom software, web development, ecommerce, AI automation, SEO and analytics, and brand identity.

## Company information
- [Student Builder Program](https://hanovadevs.com/student-builder-program): Active October–December 2026 cohort; approximately eight weeks, virtual. Eleven named student builders, the full HanovaDevs team as mentors, real project exposure, GitHub collaboration, certificates and small rewards. Selected ideas may be discussed for further support and potential investment; funding is not guaranteed. Certificate preview is a sample, not an issued credential.
- [About and founder](https://hanovadevs.com/about): Company story, founder profile, and frequently asked questions.
- [Ali Haider](https://ali.hanovadevs.com): Founder website supplied by HanovaDevs.
- [Hira Maqsood](https://hanovadevs.com/team/hira-maqsood): Co-founder and Chief Operating Officer; original ideas, creative problem-solving, strategic planning, operations and delivery.
- [Ali Haider company profile](https://hanovadevs.com/team/ali-haider): Founder and CEO; company direction and business strategy. Founded HanovaDevs in 2022.
- [Noor Fatima](https://hanovadevs.com/team/noor-fatima): Chief Marketing Officer; brand direction and marketing communication. Profile artwork is an illustrated placeholder, not a photograph.
- [Faizan Javed](https://hanovadevs.com/team/faizan-javed): Chief Technology Officer; technology direction and engineering decisions.
- [Contact](https://hanovadevs.com/contact): Project enquiries; contact@hanovadevs.com.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/hanova-devs): Company profile.

## Products
- [Eunoia](https://hanovadevs.com/products/eunoia): Desktop personal workspace; available on Microsoft Store.
- [Eunoia official store listing](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PJ36VD01Z4X): Current release, requirements and store availability.
- [Omnai Browser](https://hanovadevs.com/products/omnai): AI-focused desktop browser, launching soon. Public release date not announced.
- [Stepsy](https://hanovadevs.com/products/stepsy): HanovaDevs mobile app project connecting walking with planned points and partner rewards. Pakistan is the intended first market. Product preview only; launch availability, supported devices, merchants and reward terms are not finalised. Official domain: stepsyapp.com.
